---
name: Retiring a project
about: Checklist for retiring a project
title: Retiring <project name>
labels: Retiring
assignees: ''

---

* [ ] Update the repository
  * [ ] Update README badge. Set it at stage 4.
  * [ ] Update README header adding information about the status of the project.
  * [ ] Update the `publiccode.yml` editing `developmentStatus` field
* [ ] Archive the project's repositories.
